A few sweet details

Good to know
before you order.

Still have a question?
Send Pasha a message

How far ahead should I order?

Please give Pasha one week’s notice. Every cookie is made to order, so a little planning helps make your box extra special. Need cookies sooner? Email pashabakess@gmail.com and Pasha will let you know what’s possible.

Where do I pick up my cookies?

Pickup only in Tyngsboro, MA, normally between 10am and 7pm (Eastern time). You choose your pickup time when you order. The exact address is included in your confirmation email once your payment arrives. Delivery and shipping are not offered.

Can I mix and match the flavors?

Yes! Choose any mix from the current menu. Boxes are available as 4 cookies for $14, 6 for $20, 12 for $38, 24 for $76, or 36 for $114. You can also choose any other amount from 4 to 36 cookies at $3.50 per cookie. The minimum order is 4 cookies. Monthly specials can only be picked up during their month; the order form shows which flavors are available for your pickup date. For orders above 3 dozen (36 cookies), send Pasha an inquiry to arrange whole dozens and confirm pricing.

What flavors do you have?

Four signature flavors are available all year: Chocolate Chunk, Biscoff, Chocolate Sea Salt Toffee and Red Velvet. There are also monthly specials that change through the year. See this month’s flavors on the menu.

How much is a dozen cookies?

A dozen (12 cookies) is $38. Boxes are 4 cookies for $14, 6 for $20, 12 for $38, 24 for $76 and 36 for $114, with any mix of flavors.

Do you deliver or ship?

No. Pashabakess is pickup only, in Tyngsboro, MA. The exact pickup address is included in your confirmation email.

How should I store my cookies?

They are best enjoyed within the first few days. However, if you don’t eat them immediately, please transfer them to a Ziploc bag or an airtight container as soon as possible to maintain their freshness.

Are the cookies suitable for food allergies?

Pashabakess is not allergen-free. The cookies are not free of peanuts, tree nuts, gluten, dairy/eggs, soy, or food coloring, so they are not suitable for peanut, tree nut, gluten, dairy/egg, soy, or food coloring allergies. Everything is prepared in the same kitchen using shared equipment, trays, utensils, and packaging areas. Because cross-contact can happen, Pasha does not recommend ordering or sharing the cookies with anyone who has food allergies.

Are your ingredients halal?

Yes. All ingredients used in Pashabakess cookies are halal, including items such as marshmallows. If you have a question about a specific ingredient, please email Pasha before ordering.

How do ordering and payments work?

Order on the Order page with one week’s notice: build your box, choose a pickup date and time, and place your order. You’ll then see your order number and payment details, and they’re emailed to you too. Right away, send the total with Venmo (@Palosha-Rashid) or Cash App ($Pashabakess) and write your order number in the payment note. Pasha confirms your order, and emails you the pickup address, once your payment arrives. Nothing is charged on this website. Please pay right away; your pickup date is held for you for 24 hours.

What is the cancellation and refund policy?

Because every order is baked fresh, cookies can’t be returned or exchanged. To cancel or reschedule your pickup, email pashabakess@gmail.com at least two calendar days before your pickup date (for a Saturday pickup, by Thursday). With that notice you’ll receive a full refund to the Venmo or Cash App account you paid from, sent within 3–5 business days. Cancellations with less notice can’t be refunded. Missed pickups: you have two days after your pickup date to collect your order. Orders not picked up by then can’t be refunded. If Pasha has to cancel your order (for example, if your pickup date becomes fully booked), you’ll receive a full refund.

When do I pay?

Right after you place your order. You’ll see the payment details straight away, and they’re emailed to you too. Pasha confirms your order once your payment arrives, and your pickup date is held for you for 24 hours. If your payment doesn’t arrive by then, the date may go to someone else and Pasha may cancel the order.

I paid but haven’t received a confirmation email.

First check your spam or promotions folder. Pasha confirms each order after she sees your payment, so the confirmation isn’t instant. If you still haven’t heard back, send Pasha a message with your order number (it starts with PB), or email pashabakess@gmail.com.

Can I change or reschedule my order?

Yes. Email pashabakess@gmail.com with your order number at least two calendar days before your pickup date, and Pasha will help you change or reschedule it. You can also use the contact form.

What if I miss my pickup?

You have two days after your pickup date to collect your order. Message Pasha with your order number to arrange a time, using the contact form or pashabakess@gmail.com. Orders not picked up within two days can’t be refunded.

How is my information used?

Only to handle your order or inquiry: to prepare your cookies, match your payment, arrange pickup and email you. Your details are never sold or used for marketing. Read the privacy notice for the full details.
